newsSince: RoboSense reported Q1 2026 total LiDAR sales of 330,300 units, with robotics LiDAR shipments of 185,500 units, up 1,458.8% YoY and above automotive ADAS for the first time. It also disclosed partnerships with nearly 50 humanoid/quadruped robot companies and annual capacity for 4 million LiDAR units.

sources.label: BigGo: RoboSense Q1 robot LiDAR shipments surge 1,458%
Simply Wall St: RoboSense Q1 loss revives profitability concern

verdicts.rankRationale: This is one of the strongest evidence upgrades on the page: robotics shipments surpassed ADAS, grew 1,458.8% YoY, and the company is tied to nearly 50 humanoid/quadruped customers. It is no longer as hidden, but the shipment data is too direct to ignore.
verdicts.bull: #1 global robotics LiDAR; robot volumes now exceed auto; FY26 2-2.7M unit guide; cleaner robotics pure-play than peers.
verdicts.neutral: Volume leadership real but margins thin; equity raise dilutes; -40% YTD reflects sentiment reset.
verdicts.bear: Follow-on dilution, cash-burn, LiDAR ASP erosion; robotics LiDAR still pre-profit at scale.
verdicts.primaryCatalyst: Robotics LiDAR volume ramp / FY26 2-2.7M guide
